name: Medium Armor Master
summary: +1 Str or Dex; in Medium armor, add up to 3 from Dexterity to AC if your Dexterity is 16 or higher.

benefits.name: Dexterous Wearer
benefits.summary: In Medium armor, add 3 rather than 2 to AC when your Dexterity score is 16 or higher.
benefits.text: While you are wearing Medium armor, you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC if you have a Dexterity score of 16 or higher.
